children: WhiteHorse Finance said its board has formed a special committee of independent directors to explore strategic alternatives, including a potential sale.

The committee hasn't set a timeline for the review, and there can be no assurance it will result in any strategic transaction, the company said in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Tuesday.

WhiteHorse added that it doesn't intend to comment on the review unless the committee has approved a definitive course of action, the review has concluded, or it is otherwise determined that further disclosure is appropriate or required by law.
